LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 5.3.1 WORD CLASSES: ADJECTIVES

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.3: Grammar in use 5.3.1 Word Classes: Adjectives
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in use 5.3.1 Word Classes: Adjectives, part of Strand 5 in Grade 4 ENGLISH LANGUAGE.

Key inquiry question: Why should we say the correct shape and size of things? 2. Which are some of the words you use to talk about how someone feels or looks?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. identify adjectives from an audio or written text,

2. collaboratively talk about various items in the classroom using adjectives,

3. describe items using the comparative forms of regular and irregular adjectives with peers,

4. use adjectives in the correct order in sentences collaboratively,

5. write correct sentences using comparative forms of adjectives in the right order,

6. write sentences on tablets, computers and other digital resources using adjectives,

7. use adjectives to talk about scenes, pictures or comics based on the themes with peers. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. identify adjectives from an audio or written text,
2. collaboratively talk about various items in the classroom using adjectives,
3. describe items using the comparative forms of regular and irregular adjectives with peers,
4. use adjectives in the correct order in sentences collaboratively,
5. write correct sentences using comparative forms of adjectives in the right order,
6. write sentences on tablets, computers and other digital resources using adjectives,
7. use adjectives to talk about scenes, pictures or comics based on the themes with peers. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Grammar in use 5.3.1 Word Classes: Adjectives together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and Collaboration: This is developed as the learner uses adjectives correctly in sentences as they interact

with peers.

• Self-efficacy is developed as the learner is able to gain confidence as they use adjectives accurately in their day-to-day

communication.

Values:
● Unity: It is promoted as learners cohesively relate with each other to perform activities such as identifying and

discussing adjectives.

● Responsibility: This is cultivated as the learner takes personal initiative to complete assigned roles.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner is able to connect the concept of comparative adjectives to the learning of adjectives in English and Kiswahili.
